# Grid

Bring continuity and consistency across all screens of the same application.
See [Grid guidelines<i class="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/visual-styles/grid/)

The `Row` and `Col` components, used together, unleash the full power of our 12-column grid system.
It allows a lot of flexibility in terms of responsive layouts.

See the supported <LinkTo kind="General/Layout/Introduction" story="docs">breakpoints</LinkTo>

<Source code="import { Row, Col } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

- Any other props supplied will be provided to the root elements

## Examples

Custom CSS used in this page examples
```css
.bg-coolgrey-10 { background-color: #eff1f4; }
.bd-warmgrey-50 { border: 1px solid #c5d3db; }
.p-1 { padding: 1rem; }
.h-fill { height: 100%; }
```

### Basic

In this example all columns in each row will have equal width.<br />
The third row will display differently depending on browser width

- &lt; xs : 1 column
- &ge; xs : 3 columns
- &ge; md : 6 columns

### Reordering

The visual order of the columns can be controlled by breakpoint with the following priorities : first, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, last

<Canvas of={RowStories.Reordering} />

### Offsetting

Move columns to the right by applying offsets depending on breakpoints: from 0 to 11 columns
